segments.text: So at year one, you should have five separate visits for vaccines rather than giving them all in the same day.
An executive order does not replace scientific evidence.
The combination MMR vaccine has been shown to be safe.
There is no evidence that it needs to be separated.
That just means unnecessary extra visits.
More days off to take your babies in.
And a higher likelihood of missing doses.
Also, there has been no evidence that any of the childhood vaccinations cause autism.
Leave healthcare to the healthcare professionals.
